title: Refining Pulpal Diagnostics for Predictable Vital Pulp Treatment
html: Vital pulp treatment (VPT) comprises a range of biologically based procedures aimed at preserving pulp vitality, reducing the need for invasive interventions, and improving long-term tooth survival. Despite growing evidence supporting these approaches, their implementation in clinical practice remains limited by the lack of reliable methods for accurately assessing the inflammatory status of the dental pulp and by the continued use of diagnostic terminology that does not adequately support pulp-preserving treatment strategies.
